# Templates

This folder contains importable node-graph templates and a short usage note for the AI Agent sandbox.

- `ai-agent-demo-template.json` is a direct import file for the Manager Node Graph. Use Node Graph
  `Import Graph` first; the Manager also accepts this file from `Import Templates` for compatibility.
- `ai-agent-demo-template.md` explains how to use the imported green AI Space.
